name: live-sessions help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:live-sessions (Live sessions).
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Live sessions
entries.text: Opens the grid of every Claude session going on: human and headless, on every account, with the agent running each.

entries.title: Session recordings
entries.text: Opens the Session browser: every recorded human session, searchable, with real-time playback.

entries.title: Watch live
entries.text: Opens a live view of one session's output; voice too on a human session whose phone runs AmberX.

entries.title: Watch live
entries.text: Streams this session live: messages, tool calls and results. Brett only; the person on a human session sees 'You're being watched'.

entries.title: Who's running this session?
entries.text: Picks the crew agent this session works as. One agent can't run two live human sessions at once.

entries.title: Human / Headless
entries.text: All, only sessions with a person on them, or only headless builds and agent jobs.

entries.title: Grid / List
entries.text: Cards in a grid (tap the arrow to fold a card to its avatar and name) or one row each.

entries.title: Ended too
entries.text: Also shows sessions that ended in the last week.

entries.title: Jump to live
entries.text: Scrolls to the newest output and drops voice that piled up while paused.

entries.title: Pop out
entries.text: Opens this watch in its own window.

entries.title: Play
entries.text: Replays the session in real time: the context window fills in as it did, in sync with the voice.

entries.title: Speed
entries.text: Plays back at 0.5x to 4x.

entries.title: Skip silence
entries.text: Jumps over the stretches where nobody was talking.

entries.title: In context now
entries.text: Shows what was in the context window at this moment: tokens and what had been compacted.

entries.title: Export
entries.text: Downloads the whole recording (log and audio) as a zip file.

entries.title: Keep forever
entries.text: Pins the recording so retention never deletes it.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: Deletes the recording for good after you confirm. Brett only, logged.

entries.title: Recordings › Storage
entries.text: Where recordings live: their own container (the primary) plus mirrors in a VPS container, a private repo (Git LFS) or a device.

entries.title: Move
entries.text: Moves every recording to a new path, checking each file's hash before the old copy is deleted.

entries.title: Watch log
entries.text: Every watch start and stop, refused watch, delete, export, move and storage change.

entries.title: Show the sessions count on the banner
entries.text: Shows or hides the '2 human · 4 headless' widget on the banner.

entries.title: Live sessions
entries.text: The grid of every Claude session going on, human and headless.

entries.title: Who's running this session?
entries.text: Picks the crew agent this session works as; the last pick on that account and device becomes the default.

entries.title: Human
entries.text: Only sessions with a person on them: Claude Code terminals, claude.ai chats and voice, AmberX.

entries.title: Headless
entries.text: Only headless builds and agent-swarm jobs (no person on the other end, no voice).

entries.title: Account
entries.text: Only sessions on one Claude account: main (Brett) or a helper.

entries.title: Agent
entries.text: Only the sessions one crew agent is running.

entries.title: Play from here
entries.text: Moves the player to this message and plays on from there.

entries.title: Favourites
entries.text: Shows only the recordings you starred.

entries.title: Search every transcript
entries.text: Finds recordings by anything said or done in them: words, builds, tools.

entries.title: Sessions
entries.text: Back to the list of recordings.

entries.title: Record every human session
entries.text: Records the context-window log and both sides of the voice for every human session. On by default; the session shows 'Recording' while it's on.

entries.title: Container
entries.text: The running VPS container that keeps a mirror of the recordings.

entries.title: Path inside it
entries.text: The folder inside that container the recordings are copied to.

entries.title: Repo
entries.text: The GitHub repo that keeps a mirror (Git LFS). Public repos are refused unless you confirm.

entries.title: I understand, store them there anyway
entries.text: Lets recordings go to a PUBLIC repo, where anyone can read and hear them. Only Brett can tick it.

entries.title: Mirror
entries.text: Keeps a synced copy of every recording on this target.

entries.title: VPS container
entries.text: Adds a VPS container as a mirror.

entries.title: Local
entries.text: Adds a device (AmberX, a browser) that keeps its own synced copy.

entries.title: Save storage
entries.text: Saves the targets; mirrors start syncing in the background.

entries.title: Move the working store to
entries.text: A new folder for every recording. Preview first; files are hash-checked before the old copies go.
